FEDERATION OF MALAYA RUBBER EXCHANGE (AMENDMENT)
RULES 1983

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 14 and 16 of the
Federation of Malaya Rubber Exchange (Incorporation) Act 1962, 11/62.
the Corporation in General Meeting makes the following rules:

1. These Rules may be cited as the Federation of Malaya Rubber Citation and
Exchange (Amendment) Rules 1983 and shall be deemed to have ment.
come into force on the 20th February 1982.
